name: Gates of Olympus POP

features.name: Compact pay-anywhere grid
features.description: Five or more matching symbols anywhere on the 3×5 grid win, with tumbles.

features.name: Multipliers to 1,000x
features.description: Multipliers stay through a tumble sequence and are added together at the end.

features.name: Scatter jackpots
features.description: Scatter and Super Scatter combinations can award one of three jackpots, up to 25,000x.

review:
Zeus's game squeezed onto a compact 3x5 grid. Five or more matching symbols anywhere pay, wins tumble, and multipliers up to 1,000x can land in the base game and bonus, adding up at the end of each sequence.

Three scatters or Super Scatters give 15 free spins with a running multiplier total. In the base game, scatter and Super Scatter combinations can also award one of three jackpots, up to 25,000x. 96.54% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
